{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely easy to learn and use, with a low learning curve",
    "Simple, uncluttered interface focused on core project management",
    "Clear communication tools (messages, pings) for team collaboration",
    "Transparent project overview and progress tracking",
    "Predictable and straightforward pricing model",
    "Reliable performance and stability"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options compared to more flexible tools",
    "Fewer advanced features or complex automations",
    "Integrations with other software can be limited",
    "Reporting and analytics capabilities are basic",
    "May feel too simplistic for very large or complex projects",
    "Project progress tracking can be inconsistent across different tools"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Cons: 'Mobile app functionality might lack some desktop features' was replaced by 'Project progress tracking can be inconsistent across different tools' because the note '[friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool' directly contradicted the idea of transparent project overview and progress tracking, specifically regarding date-based progress."
  ]
}

pros: Extremely easy to learn and use, with a low learning curve
Simple, uncluttered interface focused on core project management
Clear communication tools (messages, pings) for team collaboration
Transparent project overview and progress tracking
cons: Limited customization options compared to more flexible tools
Fewer advanced features or complex automations
Integrations with other software can be limited
Reporting and analytics capabilities are basic
May feel too simplistic for very large or complex projects
Project progress tracking can be inconsistent across different tools
changed: Cons: 'Mobile app functionality might lack some desktop features' was replaced by 'Project progress tracking can be inconsistent across different tools' because the note '[friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool' directly contradicted the idea of transparent project overview and progress tracking, specifically regarding date-based progress.
